verdict.rationale: The Sai API endpoints use a version prefix (POST /v1/agents/message, GET /v1/agents/events, POST /v1/agents/approve), which is the product's own evidence of URL-level API versioning. Nothing in the evidence describes a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, or changelog guarantees, and the OpenAPI probe found no published spec. missing for 10: documented deprecation policy, versioning/compatibility guarantees, changelog or sunset notices, published machine-readable API spec, independent corroboration.
